title: The Clockmaker's Heir
author: Daniel El Fuego
description: A new keeper arrives at a remote lighthouse and discovers the tower runs on a strange brass mechanism the previous keeper never finished explaining.

sections.text: The ferry drops you at the rocky island. Instead of an ordinary lamp, the lighthouse hums with the sound of turning brass gears.

options.description: Climb straight to the lamp room

sections.text: The logbook's final pages describe a second light out at sea that answers the tower's rhythm, and a brass key that can silence it.

options.description: Go check the lamp room immediately

sections.text: The spiral stairs groan underfoot. Halfway up, the handrail gives way beneath your grip.

options.description: Grab the wall and keep climbing

consequence.text: You scrape hard against the stone wall to catch yourself.

sections.text: In the lamp room, the great gear engine grinds and sputters. Out on the water, a second light rises to meet it, keeping perfect time.

options.description: Turn the brass key to still the mechanism
Leave the mechanism running and signal for help

sections.text: The gears fall silent. Out on the water, the second light drifts, unanswered, and fades before dawn.
By morning a supply boat arrives, and you leave the island with the logbook tucked under your arm, the brass key still turning.
